item.title: Drake Seemingly Disses LeBron James With Shirt at Nocta Manor Retreat: ‘The Only LeBron I Rate Is Juan’
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest episode of Trending on Billboard. I'm your host, [Name]. Today, we're talking about a unlikely friendship between Drake and a professional padel player from Spain. Let's dive in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Juan Lebrón Chincoa, also known as 'The Wolf', is one of the best padel players in the world. And it turns out, he's also a friend of Drake's. Chincoa recently attended Drake's second annual Nike NOCTA retreat, where they even got a game of padel in together."
[Short clip of padel sound effects]
Host: "Chincoa took to Instagram to express his gratitude, sharing photos and videos from the retreat. But what caught everyone's attention was a picture of a shirt with a bold message: 'The only LeBron I rate is Juan'. This is a clear jab at NBA player LeBron James, with whom Drake has had a falling out."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The drama between Drake and LeBron James started during Drake's battle with Kendrick Lamar in 2024. Since then, Drake has been dissing James on numerous occasions. But with James recently signing with the Philadelphia 76ers, it looks like the two will be seeing a lot more of each other this upcoming season."
[Short clip of basketball sound effects]
Host: "Mutual friend Tristan Thompson has been trying to get the two to reconcile their differences. But with the new season just around the corner, it'll be interesting to see how things play out. Will Drake and LeBron James bury the hatchet? Only time will tell."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's it for today's episode of Trending on Billboard. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next one!"
